gaps.sentence: You go ahead; I'll catch ___ with you later.
gaps.explanation: catch up (with) = reach the same point/level as somebody.

gaps.sentence: They put ___ the meeting until everyone could attend.
They're ___ up a new office in the old warehouse district.
We've decided to do ___ a holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: do without = manage without having something.

gaps.sentence: Hold ___ a moment — I'll check if he's in.
gaps.explanation: hold on = wait (especially on the phone).

gaps.sentence: They've set ___ a new charity for homeless dogs.
The old buses are being phased ___ next year.
gaps.explanation: phase out = stop using something gradually.
